title: Island Components Group: Island Components Purchase Order Quality Clause Supplement, Revision F
summary: Island Components' November 2025 supplier supplement defines traceability, inspection, change-control, nonconformance, corrective-action, and key-characteristic requirements. Entity test: The test remains held because no repeat line outcome or surveillance finding is exposed.
key_findings: Where key characteristics are specified, the company requires variation control and a minimum Cpk of 1.33 unless otherwise approved.
Alternative-explanation test: Tests quality-control design, supplier controls, and parent-resource or capital alternatives.
Compatibility: Same company and facility identity; control design and certification are not the same output, labor, WIP, yield, defect, downtime, or delivery measures.
why_it_matters: This record either supplies a later compatible observation or tests a named Phase 56C alternative explanation without turning association into causal proof.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the Phase 56C parent dossier and stable entity identifier.
Maps the record to named alternative explanations.
Separates observed result, attribution, independent validation, and unresolved denominators.
evidence_limits: A supplier requirement is company-attributed control design, not observed first-pass yield, defects, scrap, downtime, delivery, or output.
The records support stated control design, not observed operation or causal effect.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
